scope: Optional bounded volumetric extension of the existing cloud setting; preserves0/1 and default0.

algorithm.resources: GPU-generated periodic128^3 Perlin/Worley shape and32^3 erosion, R8 each;2,129,920 payload bytes plus native overhead, allocated once per active ownership lifetime.
algorithm.sky: Quarter-resolution Low with96 nominal view steps/128 ceiling and3 light samples; half-resolution High with192 nominal/256 ceiling and5 light samples. Fixed logarithmic midpoint quadrature, early transmittance exit. No duplicate integration.
algorithm.water: Same density, phase, storm horizon and scatter functions;64 nominal reflected-ray steps/85 ceiling and3 light samples. Enhanced-water reflection option required.
algorithm.solar: Eight density samples per receiving surface, sunlight-only attenuation capped at the established28%; existing exact ground-contact light expression participates.
algorithm.time: Six independently wrapped Float64 phases integrate existing weather wind and game time. Cadence, held time, large jumps, weather closure90s/opening120s and identity/rewind reset checks.
algorithm.appearance: Adapted2200–5800m layer for the game camera; fair cumulus uses expanded shape contrast and profile erosion to form separated rounded masses. Nimbus/stratus distinguish precipitation and clearing. Distance thinning and bounded storm haze preserve a soft horizon; authored final perimeter-fog composition stays after clouds.
algorithm.fallback: Compatibility, headless and constrained-platform policy use the existing sheet. Desktop Mobile requires the native ei_sky_subpass_alpha capability. Failed noise initialization also falls back to the sheet without repeated allocation attempts.
algorithm.release: Disable/sheet/cave/active-world clear detaches shared Texture3DRD views before freeing both backing RIDs; old/retained owners cannot erase the active field. Main exit clears cloud resources.

native_dependency.note: Preserves all nine inherited engine patches; no runtime installation or release package changed.

accepted.scope: Gipat original terrain/river and Ingos close-water original geometry; day, night, rain, snow,9/20/35degree camera views; held pixels, empty density, exact cave/disable restoration; native/fallback live quality changes; three repeated resource/owner cycles per volume run.

cost.conditions: One fixed original-zone1 view, active terrain cloud shadows and enhanced-water reflections, fresh private profile then settled shaders, no concurrent engine/import/build processes. GPU timestamps measure this SubViewport; CPU values measure render submission. Root window remains800x600 while the measured SubViewport is1920x1080. These are scene-specific costs, not FPS/device rollout acceptance. Earlier look-development timing is excluded.

user_feedback.inspection: Parent independently accepted contrast fair shape and softened storm horizon. Low quarter-resolution wisp softness remains visible; doubling Low ray steps did not materially improve it and was rejected on cost/quality grounds.

limits: Bounded adaptation, not complete R1 parity: reuses existing2D weather noise instead of R1 dedicated weather map, has no temporal reprojection/history, cached solar shadow projection or spherical-atmosphere integration.

Fixed quadrature is deliberately denser to avoid paused-sky comb patterns; High costs about4.17ms more than Off in the recorded1080p RTX3090 view. Noise creation may add startup cost. No broad performance/device claim.
Only Linux desktop Vulkan/OpenGL rendered. Constrained-platform policy is code-gated; physical handheld/web/other-platform testing remains open.
Real Game loading/travel/save owner integration and full cloud3/terrain2 shader composition are parent-owned final-combined-pack checks, not counted here.
